---
title: "Real data example: Utah COVID-19"
format: html
---

This example uses the original pretrained SIR BiLSTM.  It does **not** retrain
the network.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(epiworldR)
  library(reticulate)
})

candidates <- c(".", "..", "../..")
ok <- file.exists(file.path(candidates, "DESCRIPTION")) &
  dir.exists(file.path(candidates, "R"))
project_root <- normalizePath(candidates[which(ok)[1]])

source(file.path(project_root, "R", "01_simulation.R"))
source(file.path(project_root, "R", "02_training.R"))
source(file.path(project_root, "R", "03_test_compare.R"))
```

```{r}
source(file.path(project_root, "data-raw", "utah-covid-data.R"))
last_date <- max(utah_covid_data$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
covid_data <- utah_covid_data |>
  filter(Date > last_date - 61) |>
  arrange(Date)
incidence_vec <- covid_data$Daily.Cases
stopifnot(length(incidence_vec) == 61)
```

```{r}
cal <- pretrained_sir_calibrator(package_dir = project_root)

prediction <- calibrate(
  daily_cases = incidence_vec,
  calibrator = cal,
  n = 5000,
  recov = 1 / 7
)

prediction
```
